install: bash -lc 'source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh 2>/dev/null && nvm install && nvm use; if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then npm ci; else npm install; fi; if ! command -v google-chrome >/dev/null 2>&1; then npx -y @puppeteer/browsers install chrome@stable --path "$HOME/.cache/chrome" && sudo ln -sfn "$(ls -d $HOME/.cache/chrome/chrome/*/chrome-linux64)/chrome" /usr/local/bin/google-chrome || true; fi; (fc-list :lang=zh | grep -q .) || (sudo apt-get update && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends fonts-noto-cjk) || true'
